records.title: Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs
records.reason: Attribution-guided optimization adjusts modular LLM programs using module-level attribution and memory selection. The full text evaluates task performance and parameter sensitivity, but does not establish a direct model-inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, KV-cache, quantization, offload, or serving improvement. Runtime-cost comparison against closest inference optimization work is a concrete follow-up if retained.
